d:
Rahul Gandhi launched a sharp personal attack on Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann during a rally in Sangrur. Rahul claimed that back in his Lok Sabha days, the smell of alcohol could be smelt from Mann's mouth as early as 11 AM. Reacting to this, the Aam Aadmi Party hit back, calling it extremely low-level politics. We will explain the full matter in detail on the show.
